chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who marries a woman and then dies before consummating the marriage with her.

He عليه السلام said: She is entitled to the full inheritance, and she must observe the waiting period of four months and ten days. If he had specified a mahr, meaning a dowry, for her, then she is entitled to half of it; and if he had not specified a mahr for her, then there is no mahr for her.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا: The duration of the widow's waiting period in this ruling.
key_terms.الْعِدَّةُ: The prescribed waiting period a widow must observe after her husband's death.
key_terms.الْمِيرَاثُ: The woman's legal share of inheritance from her deceased husband.
key_terms.صَدَاقًا: Another term for mahr, meaning the marriage dower.
key_terms.مَهْرًا: The dower due to the wife in the marriage contract.
key_terms.نِصْفُهُ: Half of the specified mahr owed in this circumstance.

ai.seo_question: What are the inheritance, ʿiddah, and mahr rulings if a husband dies before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a woman whose husband dies before consummating the marriage. She receives her full inheritance and must observe the death waiting period of four months and ten days, while her mahr depends on whether it had been specified: half if specified, and none if not specified.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5671 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who marries a woman and then dies before consummating the marriage with her.

Imam (as) said: "She is entitled to the full inheritance, and she must observe the waiting period (iddah) of four months and ten days. If he had specified a dowry (mahr) for her, she is entitled to half of it. However, if he had not specified a dowry, then she is not entitled to any dowry."
